business_problem: WeBank needed to launch and scale an internet-only banking model quickly while keeping infrastructure cost under control and making remote customer identity verification trustworthy enough for core account-opening and card-binding workflows.
solution_summary: WeBank used Tencent Cloud to build a de-IOE banking architecture that combined cloud infrastructure with AI-based remote identity verification. The platform runs in Tencent Cloud's finance-compliance environment, with TDSQL supporting account and transaction workloads while dedicated lines, VPN, private networking, BGP connectivity, and CDN provide secure low-latency access for customers and institutional exchanges. For onboarding and second-bank-card binding, Tencent YouTu supplies lip-reading liveness detection and facial recognition so users can be verified remotely instead of visiting offline branches. That identity step feeds directly into digital banking workflows, preserving an online service model without dropping core security controls. The result is a cloud-native banking stack that cut account-management cost by 80%, improved response performance, and delivered verification accuracy above 95% with an error rate below one per thousand.

solution_components.name: Tencent YouTu
solution_components.role: Provides facial recognition and lip-reading liveness detection for remote identity verification.

solution_components.name: TDSQL
solution_components.role: Stores banking data on a financial-grade database platform with multi-site disaster-recovery support.

solution_components.name: Private Network
solution_components.role: Connects cloud resources in an isolated environment for secure banking operations.

solution_components.name: Dedicated Line Access
solution_components.role: Links the bank to nearby Tencent Cloud nodes and external institutions with higher-performance network paths.

solution_components.name: VPN
solution_components.role: Extends secure connectivity between private-network resources and other environments in the hybrid architecture.

solution_components.name: CDN
solution_components.role: Publishes user-facing content to edge nodes so banking users can access services with lower latency and higher success rates.

data_flow: Customer account-opening and second-card-binding requests enter WeBank's online channels, Tencent YouTu runs remote liveness and facial-verification checks, verified customer and transaction data are stored in TDSQL, and dedicated lines, VPN, private networking, and CDN keep customer access and institutional data exchange secure and responsive.
business_outcome: WeBank launched an all-cloud banking model with lower operating cost, faster network response, and production facial-verification workflows that let customers complete key identity checks remotely instead of relying on offline processing.
